name: Eiffel Tower Visit
description: Iconic iron lattice tower on the Champ de Mars. Take the elevator or stairs to the top for stunning panoramic views of Paris.

name: Louvre Museum
description: World's largest art museum and home to the Mona Lisa. Explore over 35,000 artworks spanning millennia.

name: Seine River Cruise
description: Relaxing boat cruise along the Seine, passing Notre-Dame, the Louvre, and other iconic landmarks.

name: French Bistro Dinner
description: Enjoy authentic French cuisine at a traditional Parisian bistro. Try escargot, coq au vin, or crème brûlée.

name: Senso-ji Temple
description: Tokyo's oldest temple in Asakusa, featuring a stunning five-story pagoda and the famous Kaminarimon Gate.

name: Tsukiji Outer Market
description: Bustling market featuring fresh sushi, seafood, and Japanese street food delicacies.

name: Shibuya Crossing
description: Experience the world's busiest pedestrian crossing, then explore Shibuya's vibrant shopping and nightlife district.

name: TeamLab Borderless
description: Immersive digital art museum with stunning interactive light installations.

name: Statue of Liberty Tour
description: Ferry ride to Liberty Island with access to the pedestal or crown for sweeping views of Manhattan.

name: Central Park Walk
description: Explore 843 acres of urban parkland with lakes, gardens, and iconic spots like Bethesda Fountain.

name: Broadway Show
description: Catch a world-class musical or play in the Theater District — the heart of American performing arts.

name: NYC Pizza Tour
description: Sample slices from legendary pizzerias across Manhattan and Brooklyn.

name: Tower of London
description: Historic castle on the River Thames, home to the Crown Jewels and centuries of royal history.

name: British Museum
description: Free world-class museum with over 8 million works including the Rosetta Stone and Egyptian mummies.

name: Afternoon Tea
description: Classic British afternoon tea experience with scones, sandwiches, and premium teas.

name: Colosseum Tour
description: Step inside the ancient amphitheater that hosted gladiatorial contests for over 50,000 spectators.

name: Vatican Museums
description: Explore the Vatican's vast art collection, culminating in the breathtaking Sistine Chapel ceiling.

name: Roman Pasta Experience
description: Learn to make authentic cacio e pepe, carbonara, and amatriciana with a local chef.

name: Sagrada Familia
description: Gaudí's unfinished masterpiece — a breathtaking basilica blending Gothic and Art Nouveau styles.

name: La Boqueria Market
description: Vibrant public market on La Rambla with fresh produce, tapas bars, and exotic juices.

name: Burj Khalifa Observation
description: Visit the observation deck of the world's tallest building for panoramic views of Dubai.

name: Desert Safari
description: Thrilling 4x4 dune bashing, camel rides, and a BBQ dinner under the stars in the Arabian desert.

name: Grand Palace Visit
description: Thailand's most sacred temple complex featuring the Emerald Buddha and intricate architecture.

name: Street Food Night Tour
description: Guided tour through Chinatown and local markets sampling pad thai, mango sticky rice, and more.

name: Floating Market Trip
description: Visit the colorful Damnoen Saduak Floating Market where vendors sell goods from traditional boats.

name: Bosphorus Cruise
description: Scenic boat tour between Europe and Asia along the Bosphorus Strait.

name: Hagia Sophia
description: Stunning architectural masterpiece that served as a cathedral, mosque, and now museum.

name: Gardens by the Bay
description: Futuristic nature park with iconic Supertree Grove and two massive climate-controlled conservatories.

name: Hawker Centre Food Tour
description: Sample affordable Michelin-starred dishes across Singapore's legendary hawker centres.

name: Canal Bike Tour
description: Explore Amsterdam's 165 canals by bike, passing historic houses, bridges, and the Anne Frank House.

name: Van Gogh Museum
description: Home to the world's largest collection of Van Gogh's paintings, drawings, and letters.

name: Ubud Rice Terraces
description: Walk through the stunning Tegallalang rice terraces and learn about traditional Balinese irrigation.

name: Surf Lesson in Kuta
description: Beginner-friendly surf lessons on Bali's famous Kuta Beach with experienced local instructors.

name: Balinese Cooking Class
description: Market visit followed by hands-on cooking of traditional Balinese dishes like nasi goreng and satay.

name: Temple Sunset Tour
description: Visit the iconic Tanah Lot and Uluwatu temples at sunset for spectacular ocean views.

name: Tram 28 Ride
description: Ride Lisbon's iconic yellow tram through narrow streets, historic neighborhoods, and scenic viewpoints.

name: Pastel de Nata Tour
description: Visit the best pastéis de nata bakeries including the legendary Pastéis de Belém.

name: Taj Mahal Sunrise Visit
description: Witness the breathtaking ivory-white marble mausoleum at sunrise — one of the Seven Wonders of the World.

name: Old Delhi Food Walk
description: Navigate the bustling lanes of Chandni Chowk sampling chaat, paranthas, and jalebi.

name: Amber Fort Excursion
description: Explore the majestic hilltop fortress with its stunning mix of Hindu and Mughal architecture.

name: Fushimi Inari Shrine
description: Walk through thousands of vermillion torii gates winding up the sacred Mount Inari.

name: Traditional Tea Ceremony
description: Experience an authentic Japanese tea ceremony in a traditional Kyoto tea house.

name: Table Mountain Hike
description: Hike or take the cable car to the flat-topped mountain for breathtaking views of Cape Town.

name: Thermal Bath Experience
description: Relax in Budapest's famous Széchenyi or Gellért thermal baths, fed by natural hot springs.

name: Golden Circle Tour
description: Full-day tour visiting Þingvellir National Park, Geysir geothermal area, and Gullfoss waterfall.

name: Santorini Sunset Sailing
description: Catamaran cruise around the caldera with swimming stops and a Greek BBQ dinner at sunset.

name: Machu Picchu Trek
description: Full-day guided tour of the ancient Incan citadel perched high in the Andes Mountains.

name: Ha Long Bay Cruise
description: Overnight cruise through emerald waters and towering limestone pillars topped with rainforests.

name: Pyramids of Giza Tour
description: Visit the last remaining Wonder of the Ancient World, including the Great Sphinx.

name: Christ the Redeemer Visit
description: Take the cog train up Corcovado Mountain to the iconic 30m Art Deco statue.

name: Golden Gate Bridge Walk
description: Walk or bike across the iconic 2.7km suspension bridge with views of San Francisco Bay.

name: Uffizi Gallery
description: Home to masterpieces by Botticelli, Leonardo, and Michelangelo in the heart of Florence.

name: Old Town Walls Walk
description: Walk the medieval city walls for stunning views of Dubrovnik's terracotta rooftops and the Adriatic.

name: Overwater Villa Stay
description: Experience luxury in an overwater bungalow with glass floors and direct ocean access.

name: K-Pop Experience Tour
description: Visit K-pop studios, merchandise shops, and entertainment districts in Gangnam and Hongdae.

name: Charles Bridge Walk
description: Stroll across the 14th-century stone bridge adorned with baroque statues and street musicians.
